maya: Quick design check on routing editor 1 1 stuff: priority list with many rules is noisy. Sharing a quick screenshot in threads. Can we do a lightweight pass on affordances and clarity? jordan: Noted. First impressions: row height, drag handle contrast, long condition wrapping vs truncation, header scrollstick behavior. sam: Agree. Also the validation state 'No matching rule' reads like an error. Suggest softer copy: 'No rules matched the preview. Try relaxing conditions.' taylor: UI placement: 'Run simulation' sitting at far right is hard to find. Users expect simulation control near the preview pane or title. Propose moving it beside the preview header and adding a live vs one-off toggle. lee: a11y: drag handle contrast is low (~2.2:1). Need >=4.5:1 for UI controls. Recommend darkening or adding strong focus outline. maya: Can you propose a small CSS sample? lee: Sure: ```css .drag-handle { color: #60666a; } .drag-handle:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0A84FF; outline-offset: 2px; } ``` taylor: Support keyboard reorder: Space to pick up, arrow keys to move, Space to drop. Also surface aria-describedby when reorder active. sam: Use `aria-describedby=\"rule-reorder-instructions\"` and toggle it when reorder mode is on. design-bot: Checklist: density, contrast, keyboard reorder, preview control placement, validation tone & copy, sticky priority header. maya: Preview updates should be announced: add `aria-live=\"polite\"` to preview list container so SRs hear updates. jordan: Example snippet: ```html
...
``` sam: Copy: replace 'Invalid rule' with 'Conflicting rule' when there's an explicit conflict. Provide a small 'View conflict' link that focuses the conflicting rule. Less alarming for users. taylor: Tie-breaker case: when priorities equal, show a tooltip with created timestamp or rule id so it's not opaque. lee: I'll file the a11y ticket with acceptance criteria and contrast numbers. Anyone pairing on tests? maya: I'll prototype compact vs expanded rows plus sticky number column and keyboard reorder demo. ETA: EOD Friday. jordan: Action items: Maya - prototype; Lee - a11y ticket + tests; Sam - update validation copy & 'View conflict' action; Taylor - move preview toggle and add live/one-off; Jordan - 20-min sync Monday to review. ana-bot: Heads up: linked design PR #812 and will watch for the a11y ticket number. maya: Thanks! I'll drop the mocks in the thread when ready; please call out anything that blocks signoff. jordan: Please include focus states and contrast variants in mocks. :thumbsup:
